notes.title: This version of War Trigger 2 has been discontinued!
notes.content:
Please use this copy of War Trigger 2:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/732730/War_Trigger_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/732730/War_Trigger_2/[/url]

There was an error that resulted in 2 versions of War Trigger 2. We have retired this copy of War Trigger 2. Please remove/hide this copy from your library and computer.

Your account will remain the same.
